coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted web searches. No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was found since the prior hourly check. Fresh results included ongoing Hurricane Nolo/Lowell recovery coverage, Martha's Vineyard storm-related pantry closure reporting already retained in a prior watch, and El Paso food-bank storm damage already known from earlier Food Line monitoring; these were excluded as duplicates or without a new qualifying development. Searches for only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss surfaced older closures rather than a new event. SNAP/WIC searches did not identify a new official interruption with immediate access consequences. Donation drives, resource information, routine program promotion, historical closures, generic policy material, and unsupported claims were excluded.
